CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY

Pharmacokinetics in Elderly

A pharmacokinetic study was conducted in 18 subjects, 70 years of age or older receiving a single 15 mg oral dose of alpha.
In addition, creatinine clearance (61 mL/min), the percent of drug recovered unchanged in urine (9%), and the alpha renal clearance estimates (0.25 mL/min/kg) for the elderly were generally lower than those of younger volunteers.
